rule: The six Click tasks from the stage-delegation bench of 2026-11-10/11 (~/src/thinker-stage-bench), all eight of its read-heavy tasks that carry a check, chosen 2026-11-15 because their prompts ask for whole-file reads and so make the trigger fire -- chosen by that, not by any outcome. They measure whether quality holds when delegation fires, not how often it fires in ordinary work. A delegate session in which the hook never fired is named in the report and enters no figure. Canary first: one delegate session of long-tail, kept as rep 0 if the design is unchanged after it.
